hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: The two directed paths must intersect along a horizontal contiguous row segment.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: For any internal row, any contiguous subsegment can be formed by valid approach and departure paths.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Find the maximal subarray sum across all internal rows using the standard linear scan.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass computes maximal contiguous subsegment sums across all grid rows.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all pairs of paths in grid is exponentially intractable.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies horizontal intersection invariant and applies Kadane's algorithm.
